tools.name: price_check
tools.description: What a used car of this year, make and model really sold for. Use it for questions like 'how much is my 2019 Civic worth', 'what is it valued at' or 'what does it go for'. Shows the range most sold in, the middle price, number of sales and recent trend. Pass asking_price to see where that price sits

tools.name: compare_cars
tools.description: Compare real sold prices of two used cars side by side, with the gap between their middle prices.

tools.name: year_ladder
tools.description: Real sold prices of one model across every model year with enough sales, oldest first, with the change in middle price from one year to the next.

tools.name: budget_search
tools.description: Models whose middle sold price is at or under a budget: the newest and most-sold ones, one row per model. Optional body group, oldest year and make.

tools.name: rate_check
tools.description: Typical interest rates on real used-car loans for a credit score band, optionally for a loan length. Pass offered_apr to see where a rate sits among those loans. Not advice.

tools.name: find_model
tools.description: List model names (with the years that have sales) for a make, optionally filtered by part of a name. Use it to fix spelling before price_check.

tools.name: quote_check
tools.description: Check a whole used-car dealer quote in one call. Give the car (year, make, model), the quoted price, and the loan APR, term in months and credit score.
